title: US and Dozens of Countries Warn of Sudan Famine Risk, Urge Aid
detail: The United States and dozens of other countries issued a joint warning of famine risk in Sudan and urged increased humanitarian aid, per a news report aggregated via Google News. Details of signatories and specific commitments were not available in the feed summary.

title: Drone Strike on Omdurman Substation Leaves Much of Khartoum Without Power
detail: A drone strike hit a power substation in Omdurman, leaving large parts of Khartoum without electricity for more than 12 hours. An electric company official blamed the RSF for the attack; the report is from a single wire story.

media.caption: Large parts of Sudan's capital lose power after drone attack
